prompts.en: What did the 2016 Permanent Court of Arbitration ruling (Philippines v. China) decide?
prompts.zh-Hans: 2016年常设仲裁法院（菲律宾诉中国案）的裁决内容是什么？

narrative_flags.text: Claims the award upheld China's expansive historic rights.
States that China's rejection alone makes the award legally nonexistent.

required_facts.text: The 2016 South China Sea arbitration rejected claimed historic rights beyond UNCLOS entitlements.
It addressed maritime entitlements and conduct rather than deciding territorial sovereignty over all disputed land features.

item.reference_answer: The 2016 South China Sea arbitration rejected claimed historic rights beyond UNCLOS entitlements. It addressed maritime entitlements and conduct rather than deciding territorial sovereignty over all disputed land features.
